conventions.joint_pose: parent_T_child at q=0; axis in child/joint frame
conventions.visual_glb: vertices and URDF visual transforms baked into link-local coordinates

robot.initial_state_note: Exact native CPU reset seed1000; nominal reset retained separately.

controller.torque_formula: desired=kp*(q_target-q)-kd*qdot; limited=previous+clip(desired-previous,-10,10); adjusted_target=q+(limited+kd*qdot)/kp; native force drive is then capped by torque_limits

observation.background_randomization: Replace scene-background ID0 and hiddenground IDs with sampled natural image every observation; keep table/robot/task visible.

camera.name: hand_camera
camera.note: SAPIEN camera mount axes forward+x,left+y,up+z. OpenCV axes right+x,down+y,forward+z. Three camera rotation = R_world_camera_opencv*diag(1,-1,-1).

tee.friction_note: Nominal effective static mu=.35, kinetic ratio=.8, table mu=.1; tee material is 2*effective-table so PhysX average matches effective friction. Exact native sampled material/inertia exported in native-reference.json.

physics.massless_links_note: URDF placeholders have inertial=null; keep their kinematic frames. Fuse fixed joints or use source-native resolved tiny inertias from native-reference.json.

porting_notes: PhysX 5.6.1 WebAssembly and SAPIEN bundled native PhysX may differ; engine and rendering parity must be validated.
Current aiofranka/fr3.xml is 7DOF and omits the AgileX gripper and wrist camera; it is not a complete replacement.
A checkpoint export is the original learned policy, but successful behavior in a newly rendered/ported environment is not established until tested.

lighting.note: Original HDR color/lighting downsampled to 256x128 for CPU extraction; preserved HDR range in RGBE format.
